difficulties.name: Rookie
difficulties.description: Opponents think more slowly and make more mistakes, you have two more strikes, and beating a boss wipes every strike you have. From the second region on, opponents also play a little below their ratings: on every other setting only their thinking changes. The physics and your own team are the same on every setting, and it never changes with the score.

difficulties.name: Semi-Pro
difficulties.description: Opponents think a little more slowly than on Pro, and you have one more strike. Later opponents are stronger teams, and think more slowly to make up for it. Difficulty only ever changes how well opponents think: never their ratings, the physics or your own team, and it never changes with the score.

difficulties.name: Pro
difficulties.description: The standard game. Later opponents are stronger teams, and think a little more slowly to make up for it. Difficulty only ever changes how well opponents think: never their ratings, the physics or your own team, and it never changes with the score.

difficulties.name: All-Star
difficulties.description: Opponents think faster and make fewer mistakes. Only their thinking changes: their ratings, the physics and your own team are the same on every setting, and it never changes with the score.

kinds.name: Your shots
kinds.what: A shot pointed roughly at the net is turned toward the open corner, and scatters less.

kinds.name: Your passes
kinds.what: A pass goes to the team-mate nearest to where you point, and prefers one whose lane is open.

kinds.name: Your checks
kinds.what: Your poke check reaches wider and lands more often, your body check needs a shorter hold, and your team-mates' checks land more often.

kinds.name: Your goalie
kinds.what: When an opponent comes in with nobody in his way, your goalie reacts sooner and comes further out.

rally.name: The town rallies
rally.describe: Last season ended early. The town turns out: one more strike this season, and one more powerup to start with. Nothing is taken away for it.

trainingTraits.name: Big hits
trainingTraits.description: His body checks at speed always knock the puck loose.

trainingTraits.name: Breakaway speed
trainingTraits.description: 8% faster with the puck when nobody is between him and the net.
